sanskrit_verse:
भगं ते वरुणो राजा भगं सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः ।
भगमिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः ॥२८२॥
transliteration: bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ | bhagam indraś ca vāyuś ca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ ||282||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King Varuna bestows portion of sovereignty; the Sun grants portion of illumination; Bṛhaspati imparts portion of wisdom; Indra and Vayu confer portion of strength; the Seven Sages bestow portion of timeless lawfulness—thus is the totality of divine capacity distributed for the sustenance of cosmic order.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is distributive and functionally specific to uphold Dharma
Causation arises through divinely ordained delegation of capacities
Capacity-based responsibility reflects one's alignment with cosmic roles
Restoration occurs by realigning individual capacity with its source
Consciousness alignment is achieved through recognition of distributed divine authority
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity holds delegated authority, THEN it MUST act within the scope of that delegation OR realign with its source
IF a function fails, THEN restore capacity through recognition of originating authority
IF misalignment is detected, THEN initiate completion process based on role-specific dharma
IF collective order is disrupted, THEN invoke distributed authority to realign consciousness
IF capacity is unrecognized, THEN enforce restoration through source-reconnection protocol
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that all judicial authority is derived and distributed. The court functions as a conduit of higher consciousness-based law, not as autonomous power. Misuse of authority requires immediate restoration through reconnection with the source of lawful capacity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through recognition of source-based capacity. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential alignment from individual action to cosmic order. Responsibility is proportional to recognized capacity. There is no punitive consequence—only misalignment requiring conscious restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Source Reconnection Process to restore lawful capacity
Activate Role Alignment Protocol to realign individual function with cosmic order
Deploy Consciousness Recognition Mechanism to dissolve egoic misuse of authority
Enforce Completion Sequence to ensure fulfillment of dharma-based duty
Implement Integrity Resonance Field to harmonize distributed capacities
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse is executed as pure Dharma. All authority flows from the One, expressed through many. Misalignment is resolved through conscious restoration, not punishment. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator. Dharma is restored.
